style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: jute rope, copper bottle and a tan school bag are all warm natural browns, so the keys take the rope's own tan and Enter a berry treat beside it

images.why: Stage 'The thing tray ... holding a rope'; Phase 1 wrong line 'gives the rope a kilograms card': the rope is the thing that belongs in the length bin
images.prompt: A neat round coil of twisted golden-tan jute rope with its loose end tucked in, coarse woven fibre texture and a soft satin sheen.

images.object: tall copper water bottle, plain side
images.why: Stage 'a bottle of water'; Phase 1 wrong line 'puts the bottle of water in the length bin, because the bottle is tall': the bottle must read as a tall bottle that belongs in the capacity bin
images.prompt: A tall slim copper water bottle standing upright, seen from the side, with a rounded shoulder and a small screw cap, smooth warm polished copper with a soft glow.

images.why: Stage 'a school bag' in the thing tray; Misconception 'writing the bag's weight in centimetres': the bag is the thing that belongs in the weight bin
images.prompt: A child's school bag in warm golden-tan canvas with a front flap, two buckles and a top handle, soft cartoon stitching.
